recorded.outcome:q-seed: "the three seeds take paths of different lengths (3,731, 4,625 and 3,245 branches) and all prove the same optimum, $22,741k."

recorded.prompt:q-clock:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clock:a: "the same seed gives the same sequence of random choices"; "the same sequence of decisions every time".
recorded.prompt:q-clock:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clock:c: "With one, there is a single search, a single sequence of decisions."
recorded.prompt:q-clock:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-clock:d: The run with 1 worker, seed 7 and a deterministic limit repeats every number, so the seed is used with num_workers = 1.
recorded.prompt:q-parallel:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-parallel:a: "A wall-clock limit stops the search at a different point each run". A time limit adds variation.
recorded.prompt:q-parallel:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-parallel:b: "The deterministic limit does not help: whatever amount of work each worker is allowed, the plans it received from the others along the way were different."
recorded.prompt:q-parallel:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-parallel:c: The cause is the race: "they run on separate threads at speeds the operating system decides". "a seed is not a tuning knob to keep searching for a lucky number."
recorded.prompt:q-seed:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-seed:b: "all prove the same optimum... A proof of optimality does not depend on the path."
recorded.prompt:q-seed:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-seed:c: One-worker runs with seeds 1, 2 and 3 had different branch counts.
recorded.prompt:q-seed:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-seed:d: "One worker, a fixed seed and a deterministic limit repeat every number but the clock." A seed is "a label that makes a run repeatable."
